records.scenario: Connect to Neon Lakebase Postgres on branch 'production' (ap-southeast-1) and run DDL migration
records.expected_result: Database connection succeeds; ledger_transactions table is initialized
records.actual_result: Connected to neondb; PostgreSQL 18.6 responded; table created
records.evidence: verify-services.ts output: PostgreSQL 18.6 (4e5fd08) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu

records.scenario: Insert financial transaction into Postgres and query via REST API
records.expected_result: Transaction is inserted with generated ID and retrieved with exact amount $75,000.50
records.actual_result: Transaction ID created and matched in query result
records.evidence: POST /api/transactions returned 201; GET returned match

records.scenario: Upload test document to Neon S3 bucket 'assets' using forcePathStyle: true
records.expected_result: Object uploads successfully and returns key and byte size
records.actual_result: Uploaded test/receipt-*.txt with size 70 bytes
records.evidence: POST /api/documents returned 201; S3 PutObjectCommand 200 OK

records.scenario: List, download, and verify byte parity of stored object from S3 bucket 'assets'
records.expected_result: Downloaded content matches uploaded content with zero byte corruption
records.actual_result: Content matched verbatim; object deleted during cleanup
records.evidence: GET /api/documents/:key returned exact payload string

records.scenario: Execute npm run build with TypeScript compiler targeting NodeNext ES2022
records.expected_result: Clean compilation to dist/ with 0 type errors
records.actual_result: tsc exited with code 0; dist/ files produced
records.evidence: npm run build output: exit code 0

records.scenario: Query tenant-bound documents table using unprivileged role ledgerone_app without setting tenant context
records.expected_result: 0 rows returned; default deny (fail-closed)
records.actual_result: 0 rows returned when app.current_org_id is unset
records.evidence: adversarial-security.test.ts: ADV-SEC-001 returned 0 rows

records.scenario: Tenant A attempts to SELECT, UPDATE, and DELETE Tenant B document in same database
records.expected_result: SELECT returns 0 rows, UPDATE updates 0 rows, DELETE deletes 0 rows
records.actual_result: SELECT: 0 rows, UPDATE: 0 rows, DELETE: 0 rows
records.evidence: adversarial-security.test.ts: ADV-SEC-002 complete multi-tenant isolation confirmed

records.scenario: Attempt to insert document_chunk referencing Tenant B document while belonging to Tenant A workspace
records.expected_result: PostgreSQL throws error 23503 (foreign_key_violation)
records.actual_result: Failed with SQL error 23503 as expected
records.evidence: adversarial-security.test.ts: ADV-SEC-003 cross-tenant/cross-workspace linkage blocked by composite FK

records.scenario: Ordinary user attempts to query documents in a workspace where they have no workspace membership
records.expected_result: 0 rows returned even though user is a member of the parent organization
records.actual_result: 0 rows returned; non-member workspace access denied
records.evidence: adversarial-security.test.ts: ADV-SEC-004 workspace membership boundaries strictly enforced

records.scenario: Deactivated user membership (is_active = false) attempts to access documents in assigned workspace
records.expected_result: 0 rows returned; inactive memberships immediately fail-closed
records.actual_result: 0 rows returned for inactive membership
records.evidence: adversarial-security.test.ts: ADV-SEC-005 inactive membership strictly blocked

records.scenario: Viewer role attempts to UPDATE or DELETE document via direct SQL
records.expected_result: SELECT succeeds; UPDATE modifies 0 rows; DELETE deletes 0 rows
records.actual_result: Viewer permitted to read; direct UPDATE and DELETE modified 0 rows
records.evidence: adversarial-security.test.ts: ADV-SEC-006 viewer direct SQL mutation blocked

records.scenario: Reviewer attempts to verify extracted_fields and modify documents table
records.expected_result: Reviewer successfully verifies field (is_verified = true), but UPDATE on documents modifies 0 rows
records.actual_result: Field verified successfully; document modification affected 0 rows
records.evidence: adversarial-security.test.ts: ADV-SEC-007 reviewer field verification allowed, doc edit blocked

records.scenario: Ordinary user attempts to delete or alter their own or other workspace memberships
records.expected_result: DELETE deletes 0 rows; only admins can delete memberships
records.actual_result: DELETE affected 0 rows; self-deletion blocked
records.evidence: adversarial-security.test.ts: ADV-SEC-008 ordinary user membership tampering blocked

records.scenario: Checkout pooled connection previously bound to Tenant A without setting new context
records.expected_result: RESET ALL clears session state; subsequent query returns 0 rows
records.actual_result: Connection checked out cleanly; 0 rows returned
records.evidence: adversarial-security.test.ts: ADV-SEC-009 zero tenant context leak on pooled checkout

records.scenario: Unprivileged role ledgerone_app attempts UPDATE and DELETE on audit_logs table
records.expected_result: Both operations throw PostgreSQL error 42501 (insufficient_privilege)
records.actual_result: UPDATE: 42501 permission denied, DELETE: 42501 permission denied
records.evidence: adversarial-security.test.ts: ADV-SEC-010 audit logs immutable by application role

records.scenario: Validate PDF/PNG/JPEG/TIFF magic bytes, check structural PDF %PDF- and %%EOF markers, and reject PE/ELF executables
records.expected_result: Valid PDF accepted; malformed PDF missing %%EOF rejected; PE executable rejected
records.actual_result: Valid PDF accepted; malformed PDF missing %%EOF rejected; PE executable rejected
records.evidence: queue-and-upload.test.ts: UPLOAD-001 structural parser and security validation verified

records.scenario: Register upload intent, upload bytes to S3, confirm upload by verifying actual S3 byte SHA-256 checksum
records.expected_result: Document status becomes QUEUED; document_jobs entry created with QUEUED status
records.actual_result: SHA-256 checksum matched verbatim; document and job queued atomically
records.evidence: queue-and-upload.test.ts: UPLOAD-002 two-phase checksum saga completed

records.scenario: Tampered content uploaded to S3 with mismatched declared hash; confirmUpload detects tampering
records.expected_result: Checksum mismatch detected; S3 object purged; document marked FAILED_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH
records.actual_result: Tampered upload detected and blocked; S3 object purged; status FAILED_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH
records.evidence: queue-and-upload.test.ts: UPLOAD-003 checksum mismatch detected and purged

records.scenario: Attempt duplicate confirmUpload call on already-confirmed document
records.expected_result: Rejected with error preventing duplicate enqueueing
records.actual_result: Document row lock and status check prevented duplicate confirmation
records.evidence: queue-and-upload.test.ts: UPLOAD-004 duplicate confirmation blocked

records.scenario: Janitor sweep transitions abandoned uploads from UPLOAD_PENDING -> CLEANUP_PENDING with lease, purges S3, sets UPLOAD_EXPIRED
records.expected_result: Stale upload transitioned to UPLOAD_EXPIRED and unconfirmed S3 objects cleaned
records.actual_result: Swept 1 abandoned document, transitioned to CLEANUP_PENDING and then UPLOAD_EXPIRED
records.evidence: queue-and-upload.test.ts: UPLOAD-005 durable janitor sweep verified

records.scenario: Two concurrent workers claim jobs simultaneously using FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
records.expected_result: Workers receive mutually exclusive job assignments; zero double-processing
records.actual_result: Worker 1 and Worker 2 claimed distinct jobs
records.evidence: queue-and-upload.test.ts: QUEUE-001 concurrent SKIP LOCKED verified

records.scenario: Worker claims job; database atomically mints unique UUID fencing token and increments lease_generation
records.expected_result: Claimed job returns valid UUID fencing_token and incremented lease_generation
records.actual_result: Fencing token minted and lease generation incremented to 1
records.evidence: queue-and-upload.test.ts: QUEUE-002 fencing token and monotonic generation verified

records.scenario: Worker with stale/superseded fencing token or worker_id attempts heartbeat renewal or job completion
records.expected_result: Rejected with false (rowCount === 0); stale worker prevented from mutating state
records.actual_result: Stale worker operations strictly rejected by fencing token check
records.evidence: queue-and-upload.test.ts: QUEUE-003 stale worker rejection via fencing token verified

records.scenario: Worker completes job; verify job and document status transition atomically to COMPLETED in single transaction
records.expected_result: Both document and job atomically marked COMPLETED in same transaction
records.actual_result: Transactional coordination between job and document verified
records.evidence: queue-and-upload.test.ts: QUEUE-004 atomic document/job completion verified

records.scenario: Worker crashes leaving active lease; reaper reclaims expired job with retry increment and exponential backoff
records.expected_result: Job returned to QUEUED status with incremented retry count and future scheduled_at
records.actual_result: Reaper recovered 1 job; retries incremented to 1; backoff applied
records.evidence: queue-and-upload.test.ts: QUEUE-005 reaper recovery with exponential backoff verified

records.scenario: Initiate S3 multipart upload on Neon bucket 'assets', upload Part 1 (5MB) and Part 2 (1MB), complete upload, verify assembled byte integrity
records.expected_result: 6MB object assembled cleanly across parts; downloaded byte SHA-256 matches verbatim
records.actual_result: 6MB object assembled; downloaded SHA-256 matched verbatim; S3 object cleaned up
records.evidence: s3-multipart.test.ts: S3-MP-001 multipart upload and assembly verified

records.scenario: Initiate multipart upload, upload partial 5MB part, call AbortMultipartUpload, verify object does not exist in bucket
records.expected_result: AbortMultipartUpload reclaims storage; aborted object is confirmed absent
records.actual_result: Upload aborted; object verified absent from bucket
records.evidence: s3-multipart.test.ts: S3-MP-002 abort multipart upload verified

records.scenario: Register user with email, password, full name, and verify duplicate email rejection
records.expected_result: User created with hashed password; duplicate registration returns 400 Bad Request
records.actual_result: User created, password_hash excluded from API response, duplicate rejected with 400
records.evidence: auth-and-workspaces.test.ts: AUTH-001 registration & duplicate rejection verified

records.scenario: Authenticate with valid credentials to obtain JWT access and refresh tokens; reject bad password
records.expected_result: Invalid login returns 401; valid login returns access and refresh tokens
records.actual_result: Invalid login returned 401; valid login issued valid JWT tokens
records.evidence: auth-and-workspaces.test.ts: AUTH-002 authentication and JWT issuance verified

records.scenario: Verify tampered JWT is rejected with 401; refresh token flow issues fresh access token
records.expected_result: Tampered token rejected with 401; refresh endpoint returns 200 with new accessToken
records.actual_result: Tampered token rejected; refresh endpoint issued fresh accessToken
records.evidence: auth-and-workspaces.test.ts: AUTH-003 tamper rejection & refresh token flow verified

records.scenario: Onboard organization: creates org, default 'general' workspace, assigns ORGANIZATION_ADMIN, writes audit log
records.expected_result: Org and default workspace created; creator is ORGANIZATION_ADMIN; audit log created
records.actual_result: Org created, default workspace created, admin membership verified in DB, audit log confirmed
records.evidence: auth-and-workspaces.test.ts: TENANT-001 organization onboarding verified

records.scenario: Create second workspace; assign analyst to it; verify RLS allows analyst to see ONLY assigned workspace
records.expected_result: Analyst user only retrieves the assigned workspace, general workspace is hidden by RLS
records.actual_result: Analyst retrieved exactly 1 assigned workspace; general workspace completely isolated
records.evidence: auth-and-workspaces.test.ts: TENANT-002 multi-workspace RLS isolation verified

records.scenario: Verify role permission boundaries: ANALYST blocked from workspace creation and document upload
records.expected_result: ANALYST receives 403 Forbidden on workspace creation and document upload
records.actual_result: Both unauthorized operations returned 403 Forbidden as required
records.evidence: auth-and-workspaces.test.ts: RBAC-001 role permission enforcement verified

records.scenario: Execute full HTTP workflow: register upload intent, PUT to S3, confirm upload, verify QUEUED status and job
records.expected_result: 201 on intent with S3 key; S3 PUT succeeds; 200 on confirm; document and job in QUEUED status
records.actual_result: Saga executed end-to-end; document transitioned to QUEUED; document_jobs entry QUEUED
records.evidence: auth-and-workspaces.test.ts: E2E-SAGA-001 full document upload saga verified

records.scenario: Background ingestion worker polls queue, claims job via SKIP LOCKED, processes document, writes chunk, and completes job
records.expected_result: Worker claims job, document and job status transition to COMPLETED, chunk persisted
records.actual_result: Worker claimed job, executed pipeline, inserted chunk, completed job, released locks
records.evidence: ingestion-worker.test.ts: WORKER-001 execution verified
